_doc: The reward the Shooter Z AI learns from. One weight per term; the reward of a decision (1/20 s) is the sum of weight x term.
Terms marked helper fade from 100% to 0% over the second half of self-play, so the final AI plays to win, not to farm points.
Every term is logged on its own (reward/<name>), so you can see which part drives the agent.
The benchmark never uses this file: it reports wins, K/D, headshots and damage directly.

won.doc: once, when the match ends in a win (first to the score limit).

lost.doc: once, when the match ends in a loss.

damageDealt.doc: per point of damage dealt (100 = one elimination's worth; headshots already do 2.5x damage).

damageTaken.doc: per point of damage taken. Cover is learned from this; being in cover is never rewarded directly.

wastedShots.doc: per shot that hit nothing (shots - hits). Against spraying.

noProgress.doc: per decision after 10 s with no damage dealt or taken (about -0.1 a second). Against camping; brief waiting is free.

kills.doc: per elimination (off: damage already covers it).

headshots.doc: per headshot hit, on top of the higher damage (off at first).
